historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2027 company guidance (+6%, JPY710bn), cross-checked against revenue 3yr CAGR 6.2% and the equity 5yr CAGR of 9.6%
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on repo FY labels, FY2021->FY2026 (5yr) and FY2023->FY2026 (3yr). FCF CAGRs use the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less interest/dividend income): FY2021 30,919; FY2022 55,962; FY2023 52,673; FY2024 51,048; FY2025 48,572; FY2026 76,843. The 5yr FCF CAGR is flattered by the COVID-trough FY2021 base and the 3yr by the FY2026 inventory release; neither is a forward growth rate. Owner-FCF CAGR is slightly below reported-FCF CAGR because interest income has grown with the cash pile (1,380 -> 5,270), not because SBC is growing. Equity CAGR includes JPY121.6bn of cumulative FX translation gains (yen weakness), so the 9.6% overstates organic book compounding; the selected rate is therefore anchored on guidance and revenue rather than on equity.

scenario_narratives.base: Two engines pulling in opposite directions. Digital Society (semiconductor-equipment ceramics, electrostatic chucks, AlN heaters, HICERAM Carrier for AI packaging) keeps compounding high-single to low-double digits on AI-driven fab capex, taking the segment from JPY205bn toward JPY320-330bn by FY2031, while Environment (58% of sales) treads water: honeycomb and DPF/GPF unit volumes fall with EV penetration but EU7/Tier-3/China-7 sensor and GPF content and pricing hold the segment's revenue roughly flat. Insulators grow mid-single digits on grid and data-centre investment; the NAS battery wind-down removes a loss-maker. Group revenue grows 6% in FY2027 per guidance and decelerates to 2% by Y9; EBITDA margin edges from 23.5% to 24.5% as the mix shifts. The JPY450bn five-year capex plan (new Komaki semiconductor-ceramics plant from October 2029) holds owner FCF near JPY65-70bn through Y5 before it rises to ~JPY100bn once capex normalises to ~9.5% of sales. Terminal value is capped at 15x FCF (cyclical industrial); Gordon at 8%/2% would exceed it.
scenario_narratives.bull: The AI semiconductor capex supercycle runs for the full decade, NGK's qualified positions in etch/deposition chamber ceramics and HICERAM Carrier translate directly into share, and the Komaki plant is filled on opening. Emissions regulation keeps sensor and filter content rising fast enough that the Environment segment grows despite EV share gains, and the yen stays near JPY150/USD rather than strengthening to the JPY140 assumed in the plan. Revenue ~JPY950bn by FY2031 (above the JPY900bn target), EBITDA margin 26.5% (operating margin ~17.5%), terminal growth 2.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Both cyclical end markets turn within the forecast window. A semiconductor capex downturn in FY2029 cuts Digital Society revenue just as the capacity committed in 2027-2029 comes online, dropping utilisation and margins; concurrently EV penetration (company's own forecast: 30-34% of new vehicles by 2030) erodes substrate and filter volumes faster than sensor mix can offset, and the tariff-driven pull-forward in FY2026 auto demand reverses. Energy and raw-material costs flagged by management (Middle East) stay elevated. Revenue dips 2% in FY2029 and only reaches ~JPY760bn by FY2031; EBITDA margin troughs at 19.5% and settles at 21.5%. The NV1000 new businesses, like NAS before them, do not reach scale. Terminal growth 1%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A cash-rich ceramics duopolist in a shrinking automotive market, re-rated by the market in 2025-26 as an AI semiconductor-equipment supplier (52-week range JPY2,588-7,894 against a price now in the middle of it). The house value is driven by three things: how fast Digital Society grows into the JPY450bn capex plan, how slowly the Environment franchise erodes under EV penetration, and the JPY163bn of cash and securities on the balance sheet. Owner FCF strips interest/dividend income and the FY2026 inventory release; the forward FCF margin is built from guidance-anchored components, not carried flat. Terminal value is capped at 15x FCF because the business is cyclical and both end markets are capital-intensive.
key_risks_to_valuation: Semiconductor capex cycle turning after the JPY450bn capex plan is committed (new Komaki plant opens October 2029)
EV penetration eroding automotive substrate/filter volumes faster than sensor and GPF mix offsets (58% of sales)
Yen strengthening toward the JPY140/USD the company's own FY2030 plan assumes; FY2026 sales and operating income benefited by JPY5.3bn/JPY0.1bn from FX
Energy and raw-material cost inflation (JPY8.8bn FY2027 headwind guided, Middle East energy prices)
Execution risk on NV1000 new businesses, given the NAS battery history (FY2012 JPY61.1bn charge, FY2026 JPY20bn exit charge)
Terminal value is ~55-60% of enterprise value and bound by the 15x cap, so the valuation is sensitive to the mature-margin assumption

inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted-average 290.930m from the FY2026 annual report EPS note (basic 290.508m + 0.422m stock options), less the 6.250m shares repurchased on 2026-05-01 and cancelled 2026-06-01 (subsequent-events note 19.c). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows; the company's flexible buybacks (JPY9-15bn/yr, JPY31bn in May 2026) more than fund a flat count.
inputs.cash_composition: Cash and cash equivalents 199,644 + time deposits 29,323 + marketable securities (investment trusts 37,082 + held-to-maturity debt securities 56,873) 93,955 at 2026-03-31. Debt = short-term borrowings 7,364 + current LTD 35,586 + long-term debt 201,686 (annual report balance sheet).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 annual report cash flow statement, share-based compensation expense JPY406m (FY2025: JPY264m); stock-option scheme only, no net-share-settlement tax line disclosed. Immaterial (0.06% of revenue) but kept explicit.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest and dividends income JPY5,270m (income statement, one combined line). Stripped from the FCF base because net cash + securities (~JPY163bn) exceeds the owner-FCF base; the matching assets (cash, marketable securities, non-current investment securities) are in net debt and the equity bridge.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 purchase of treasury stock JPY15,005m (cash flow statement). Post balance date: JPY31,006m / 6.25m shares completed 2026-05-01, carried in equity_bridge and in the share count.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in JPY; Tokyo Stock Exchange quote in JPY. No FX bridge. Company reports USD convenience translations at JPY160/USD which are ignored.
inputs.fy_label_note: Repo labels fiscal years by END year: FY2026 = year ended 2026-03-31. The company labels by START year (its 'FY2025 results' and 'FY2026 forecast' are the repo's FY2026 actual and FY2027 forecast). Y1 of the projection = repo FY2027 = company 'FY2026 forecast'.
inputs.share_count_date: 2026-06-01 (post-cancellation; base count from the 2026-03-31 annual report)
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-denominated build. 10y JGB ~1.6-1.7% (2026), JPY ERP ~5.5%, beta ~1.15 for a supplier exposed to both auto production and semiconductor capex -> cost of equity ~8.0%; after-tax cost of debt ~1.5% on JPY245bn of borrowings against a ~JPY1.3tn market cap gives a blended WACC of ~7.3%. House reference for JPY keiretsu industrials is ~9%; the company's own CAPM cost of equity is 9.3% (pre-tax WACC 11.3%, used as an internal hurdle). Base WACC set at 8.0%, between the market-derived figure and the house reference, and held identical across scenarios: cyclicality is charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate (adaptations rule f).
inputs.lease_treatment: None required. Japanese GAAP filer: operating leases are expensed in operating income; finance-lease obligations (immaterial) sit inside long-term debt and are therefore in net debt. ASBJ Statement No. 34 (new lease standard, effective from the year ending March 2028) will capitalise operating leases; when that happens the model must pick treatment (A) or (B) explicitly rather than inherit both.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the bridge: non-controlling interests JPY8,115m (2026-03-31) deducted in equity_bridge. Flows are consolidated. NCI share of profit is JPY389m (0.6% of net income), so the alternative attributable-flows approach would move the value by well under 1%.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical', owner-fcf.md plus owner-fcf-adaptations.md). NGK is an advanced-ceramics manufacturer: Environment (automotive exhaust substrates/filters/sensors, 58% of sales), Digital Society (semiconductor-equipment ceramics, HICERAM Carrier, metals, 37%) and Energy & Industry (insulators, NAS battery run-off, 10%). Owner FCF = reported FCF 82,519 - SBC 406 - interest and dividend income 5,270 = 76,843 (11.5% of revenue). FY2026 reported FCF was flattered by an inventory release (inventories fell JPY9bn while revenue grew 8%) and a 28.6% cash tax rate; the component build for Y1 gives ~JPY66bn, i.e. the forward margin is NOT the FY2026 margin carried flat. The FY2012 net loss (NAS battery fire, JPY61.1bn extraordinary loss) and the FY2026 JPY19,960m NAS exit charge are one-offs excluded from the operating base; the remaining JPY12,270m provision is a future cash cost and is deducted in the bridge. Interest/dividend income stripped and the matching assets added: cash+deposits+marketable securities in net debt, non-current investment securities (JPY84,891m fair value, mostly cross-shareholdings with JPY64.1bn of unrealised gains) in the bridge net of ~30.6% tax on the gains. 10-year horizon because the FY2027-FY2031 JPY450bn capex plan (vs JPY234bn in the prior five years) depresses FCF through Y5 and the margin only matures after the new Komaki semiconductor-ceramics plant is in service (October 2029). SBC-zero market: house and street bases coincide to within JPY10/share; band_position is reported as null.

bear.rationale: FY2027 guidance missed (energy costs, tariff pull-forward reversing in autos), then an AI/semiconductor capex downturn in FY2029 lands on freshly committed capacity while EV penetration erodes substrate volumes faster than mix offsets. Revenue ~JPY760bn in FY2031, EBITDA margin troughs at 19.5% and recovers only to 21.5% (operating margin ~12%, the FY2024 level). Capex plan partly deferred after the downturn but the Komaki plant still completes. Terminal growth 1%: the 58% automotive franchise is in structural decline.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 = FY2027 guidance (+6%, JPY710bn, Digital Society +JPY40bn, Environment flat). Thereafter Digital Society compounds ~9%/yr toward but not reaching the JPY350bn FY2031 target, Environment is flat to slightly down (EV share of new vehicles rising to ~30-34% by 2030, offset by sensor/GPF mix), insulators mid-single digit. Base revenue reaches ~JPY855bn in FY2031, ~5% below the company's JPY900bn target, which assumes NV1000 new businesses deliver JPY100bn.
base.margin_rationale: FY2027: operating income guidance JPY107bn (15.1%) + depreciation guidance JPY60bn = 23.5% EBITDA. Rises to 24.5% as the semiconductor mix grows and Ceramic Packages/NAS losses drop out; that is ~15.5% operating margin on 9% D&A, below the company's 16.7% FY2031 target. SBC 0.06% explicit. Cash tax 29% (FY2026 cash tax 28.6% of pre-tax income; Japanese statutory ~30.6%, overseas mix lower).
base.capex_rationale: FY2027 guidance JPY62bn (8.7%); the FY2027-FY2031 plan is JPY450bn in total (JPY250bn Digital Society, incl. the ~JPY70bn Komaki plant built 2027-2029). Base path sums to ~JPY430bn over those five years, then fades to 9.5% of revenue against 9.0% D&A at terminal. Working capital: receivables + inventory of JPY387bn against JPY67bn payables -> growth consumes cash; capture -20% of the revenue change (below the ~48% structural NWC/revenue ratio because inventory has been falling).

bull.rationale: Company targets met or beaten: revenue ~JPY950bn by FY2031 (target JPY900bn at a stronger JPY140/USD; the yen stays near 150), EBITDA margin 26.5% (operating margin ~17.5% vs the 16.7% target). Same capex plan in percent terms, so absolute capex is higher (~JPY465bn).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the 15/50/35 default to 25/50/25. Bear raised because the company sits on two independent cycles (auto production, semiconductor capex) and a structural volume decline in its largest segment, with the FY2027-FY2031 capex committed before the demand it serves is contracted, and because the FY2012 and FY2026 NAS write-offs show new-business execution risk. Bull lowered because it needs several things to hold at once: an uninterrupted AI capex cycle through 2031, Environment revenue growing against EV penetration, and a yen that does not strengthen to the plan's JPY140 assumption.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
